tool_args.rationale: The five observations are all at H≤0.48, while the cited endogenous-adaptation mechanism predicts a sign reversal around H≈15–25. A long-horizon discriminating observation is needed to identify behavior near the target H=23.4 before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary input-response or Haldane model to the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These rows do not distinguish a stationary response from endogenous adaptation, and the target horizon is far beyond the observed H range.
A larger short-horizon batch would not resolve whether the candidate response reverses at long horizons.
It is irrelevant to the identified long-horizon ambiguity.
